nearby.intro: Works without the internet: bring teammates' phones up to date, or give a new person the app and let them join the team.
nearby.withTeammatesLine: Phones that already have LangQuest bring each other up to date. Keep this open until it says Up to date.
nearby.newPersonLine: Give a new person the app, then let them join the team from this phone.
nearby.rowSub: Share work progress with teammates without the internet
nearby.rowSubJoin: Share work progress with teammates, or bring in a new person, without the internet
nearby.rowHelp: Opens Share nearby, where phones near each other send and receive each other's work progress without the internet.
nearby.rowHelpJoin: Opens Share nearby, where phones near each other send and receive each other's work progress without the internet, and where you give a new person the app and let them join the team.
nearby.rowHelpRemind: Opens Share nearby, where phones near each other send and receive each other's work progress without the internet, and where you give a new person the app and let them join the team. This phone does not have the install file a new person's phone needs now: get it there before you go offline.

why.notInBuild: This version of the app cannot share nearby. Update it from the store.
why.androidTooOld: Share nearby needs Android 10 or later, and this phone has an older version.
why.noBluetoothLe: This phone has no Bluetooth Low Energy, which Share nearby needs.
why.noWifiDirect: This phone has no Wi-Fi Direct, which Share nearby needs.
why.noKey: This phone is not ready to share yet. Connect to the internet once, then come back.
why.noCertificate: To share nearby, this phone must connect to the internet once while your organization has Share nearby turned on.
why.readOnly: Accounts that only view organizations do not share nearby.

radios.title: Turn these on in your phone's settings, then come back:

permission.location: Android calls finding nearby phones "location". LangQuest does not record where you are. It uses this only to find teammates' phones while this screen is open.
permission.nearbyAndLocation: Android will ask twice: to find nearby devices, then for location, which Wi-Fi Direct needs. LangQuest does not record where you are.
permission.nearbyDevices: Android will ask to let LangQuest find and connect to nearby devices. It uses this only while this screen is open.
permission.precise: Android gave only approximate location, and Wi-Fi Direct needs precise location to connect. LangQuest still does not record where you are.
permission.settings: Android will not ask again. Open this app's settings, then Permissions, and allow Nearby devices or Location.
permission.allowHelp: Shows Android's question. Choose Allow to share with teammates nearby.
permission.openSettingsHelp: Opens this app's page in your phone's settings, where you can allow it.

stopped.idle: Stopped after a while with nobody new nearby.
stopped.wait: Stopped after waiting a long time for a busy teammate.
stopped.noKey: This phone cannot share yet. Connect to the internet once, then come back.
stopped.failed: Share nearby could not start Bluetooth and Wi-Fi.
stopped.lookAgainLine: If a teammate arrives, tap Look again.

nearby.lookAgainHelp: Turns on Bluetooth and Wi-Fi again to find teammates nearby.
nearby.findError: Bluetooth stopped working ({{code}}). Turn Bluetooth off and on again.
nearby.looking: Looking for teammates. Keep this screen open, and ask them to open Share nearby too.
nearby.upToDateLine: This phone is up to date with everyone nearby.

state.missed: Did not finish. It will try again.

nearby.connectHelp: Connects to this phone. Use it when a teammate is nearby but the phones have not found each other.

came.title: What came across
came.noRoom: This phone ran out of room for recordings.
came.cutBackups: Backups paused so a waiting teammate could have a turn.
came.dropped: The connection dropped before the end.
came.noAnswer: The other phone did not answer.
came.heard: The other phone ended it early.
came.failed: Something went wrong. It will try again.

nearby.clockOff: A teammate's clock and this phone's differ by more than five minutes. Check the date and time on both phones.
nearby.newerApp: A teammate's phone needs a newer version of the app to share with this one. Update the app from the store, or get the newer version from a teammate.
nearby.apkOld: The install file you got is for an older version. Get the new one before you go offline.
nearby.tooOld: This app is too old to share. Update it from the store.
nearby.farAhead: {{name}}'s phone has a date far in the future. Their work waits until it reaches the server.
nearby.olderFromServer: Older work will come from the server.
nearby.holdHelp: On, this phone keeps teammates' recordings until the server has them. Off, it keeps only the ones you need.

carry.title: Ready to carry
carry.everything: This phone holds everything it knows of.
carry.elsewhere: This phone holds as much of {{name}}'s work as it can. The rest stays on {{name}}'s phone until someone reaches the internet.
carry.elsewhereUnknown: Recordings that only phones not nearby hold: {{n}}
carry.noRoom: There is not enough room on this phone for every recording.
carry.notAll: This phone can carry the team's work, but not all of their recordings.
carry.pulled: Changes this phone got from the server can be shared only after it next reaches the internet.
carry.notSinceOnline: Not since you were last online

history.nearby: Came from {{name}}'s phone, not on the server yet
history.nearbyUnknown: Came from a teammate's phone, not on the server yet

sync.holdingHelp: Teammates' recordings on this phone that the server does not have yet. They go up when this phone is online.
sync.deliveryRefused: The server would not take {{name}}'s work from this phone: {{reason}}. It stays here and goes again at each sync.

letIn.rowHelp: Opens Let someone in, where a new phone with no internet joins your team from this phone.
letIn.intro: A new person with LangQuest on their phone joins your team from this phone, without internet. Choose their role, show them the code, and let them in once the pictures match.
letIn.needsApp: The new phone needs LangQuest installed first.

why.notInBuild: Only Android phones can let someone in.
why.noPass: This phone cannot let anyone in. Your organization must have it turned on, you must be able to invite people to this language, and this phone must have reached the internet since.
why.expired: This phone's permission to let people in has run out. Connect to the internet once to renew it.
why.noRole: There is no role this phone can give without internet. An admin can give roles after the new person reaches the internet.
why.permissions: Open Share nearby first and allow what Android asks, then come back.
why.wifiOff: Turn on Wi-Fi in your phone's settings, then come back.

letIn.roleHelp: The role the new person gets. An admin can change it after they reach the internet.
letIn.asRole: They join as {{role}}. An admin can change it after they reach the internet.
letIn.showHelp: Makes a code for the new phone to scan. It works for two minutes, for one phone.
letIn.codeLabel: The code for the new phone to scan
letIn.scanLine: On the new phone, open LangQuest, tap Scan a code, and point it here.
letIn.connected: A phone connected. Waiting for it to ask…
letIn.compare: Check that the new phone shows the same two pictures. If they differ, tap No.
letIn.whatGoes: They will get this language's work and the names of its team.
letIn.letInHelp: Lets them in with the role chosen, then sends them a starting copy of this language.
letIn.noHelp: Sends them nothing and ends the connection.
letIn.copying: Sending {{name}} a starting copy… Parts sent: {{n, number}}
letIn.doneLine: They can work now. Their account is made when their phone, or a teammate's carrying their work, reaches the internet.
letIn.anotherHelp: Starts again with a new code.
letIn.turnedAway: Another phone tried this code and was turned away.
letIn.stayOpen: Keep this screen open until it finishes.
letIn.fileExact: The file in your Downloads must have exactly this name. Any other name is the wrong version.
letIn.fileOld: The install file you got before is for an older version. Get the new one before you go offline.
letIn.getHelp: Opens your phone's browser, which downloads the install file for this version.
letIn.getLine: Download it before you go offline. The new phone must allow installing apps from other sources. Send the file to it by Quick Share, an SD card or a USB cable. Quick Share needs Google Play services on both phones.
letIn.getOffline: Getting the install file needs the internet.
letIn.checkHelp: Opens your phone's files. Choose the install file you have, and the app compares its name with the one this phone needs. Only the name is read.
letIn.checkOther: This file is for a different version: you need {{file}}
letIn.fileHelp: When everyone you came for is in, delete this file. You need internet to get it again.
letIn.picturesLabel: Two pictures. Compare them with the other phone.

end.expired: Nobody used the code in time. Make a new one.
end.noAnswer: The phone that connected did not have this code. Make a new one.
end.versions: Their app is a different version. They need {{file}}
end.versionsUnnamed: Their app is a different version. They need the install file for this phone's version.
end.clock: The two phones' clocks differ by more than five minutes. Set the right time on the new phone, then make a new code.
end.refused: This phone could not let them in under that role. Connect to the internet once, then try again.
end.dropped: The connection dropped before they were let in. Make a new code.
end.droppedAfter: They are in, but the connection dropped. Any teammate with Share nearby open can finish their starting copy.
end.copyShort: They are in, but this phone had no starting copy to give them yet. Any teammate with Share nearby open can finish it.
end.stopped: The code is gone because you left this screen. Make a new one.
end.noCertificate: This phone must connect to the internet once before it can let anyone in.
end.failed: Something went wrong on this phone. Make a new code.

installFile.intro: A new person's phone needs LangQuest installed before you can let them in. Get the file here while you have internet, and take it with you.
installFile.rowHelp: Opens Get the install file, where you download and check the file a new phone installs LangQuest from. Do it while you have internet.
installFile.linkHelp: Opens Get the install file, where you download and check the file a new phone installs LangQuest from.
installFile.remind: Get the install file before you go offline
installFile.notGot: Install file for a new person: not got yet
installFile.older: Install file for a new person: for an older version
installFile.lineHelp: A new person's phone installs LangQuest from this file. This phone has not got the one for this version yet: get it while you have internet, so you can give it to a new person offline.

join.intro: Join your team from a teammate's phone, without internet. Your account is made the first time your phone reaches the internet.
join.notInBuild: Joining without internet needs an Android phone.

notEmpty.title: This phone already holds someone's work
notEmpty.session: Someone is signed in on this phone. A new person can join without internet only on a phone with nobody on it.
notEmpty.others: Someone has used LangQuest on this phone before. A new person can join without internet only on a phone with nobody on it.
notEmpty.unsent: This phone holds work that has not reached the server. A new person can join without internet only on a phone with nobody on it.
notEmpty.local: Someone has already joined on this phone without internet. Only one person can.

join.noCode: Scan the code on your teammate's phone first.
join.name: Your name
join.nameHelp: The name your teammate sees before letting you in.
join.nameLine: When you tap Join, Android asks to let LangQuest use nearby devices. It needs this to reach your teammate's phone.
join.stale: This code may be too old. If joining fails, ask for a new one.
join.joinHelp: Reaches your teammate's phone and asks to be let in.
join.permission: LangQuest needs nearby devices to reach your teammate's phone.
join.permissionBlocked: Allow nearby devices for LangQuest in the phone's settings, then come back.
join.wifiOff: Turn on Wi-Fi in your phone's settings, then try again.
join.compare: Your teammate's phone shows two pictures. If they are the same as these, your teammate lets you in.
join.copying: You are in. Getting a starting copy of the team's work… Parts: {{n, number}}
join.unfinished: You are in, but the starting copy is not complete
join.unfinishedLine: Any teammate with Share nearby open on the same version of the app can finish it. Or it finishes by itself when this phone reaches the internet.
join.lookHelp: Finds a teammate's phone nearby to finish the starting copy.
join.looking: Looking for a teammate with Share nearby open…
join.stopLookingHelp: Stops looking. You can look again later.
join.otherVersion: A teammate's app is a different version
join.otherVersionLine: Their phone cannot finish your starting copy. A teammate on the same version can, or the internet will.
join.installFile: This phone no longer needs the install file. You can delete it, unless you will pass it on.
join.scanHelp: Opens the scanner for a new code from your teammate's phone.

end.notLetIn: You were not let in. Ask your teammate for a new code if you should be.
end.noAnswer: Your teammate's phone did not answer. Ask for a new code.
end.clock: This phone's clock differs from your teammate's by more than five minutes. Set the right date and time, then scan a new code.
end.versions: Your app is a different version from your teammate's. Ask them for their install file, install it, then scan a new code.
end.refused: This phone could not check your teammate's answer. Ask for a new code.
end.dropped: The connection dropped. Ask for a new code.
end.failed: Something went wrong on this phone. Ask for a new code.
